ruleDefinitions.name: Bash /dev/tcp & Socat Reverse Shell
ruleDefinitions.description: Linux Reverse Shell via Bash TCP or Socat

sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create"
AND
(
  process_command_line:RGXi("/dev/tcp/[0-9]{1,3}")
  OR
  (
    process_command_line:RGXi("socat")
    AND process_command_line:RGXi("TCP:")
    AND process_command_line:RGXi("EXEC:")
  )
)
AND NOT user="root"
